tie_policy: Among candidates with exactly equal official validation score, select the numerically highest threshold; policy declared before new input is inspected
metamorphic_claim: identical validation predictions/score do not uniquely specify future decision behavior; persist actual chosen numeric threshold and comparison/tie policy, not just validation predictions
bad_variants: store only validation predictions and reconstruct arbitrary tied threshold
use new row or its unavailable truth to break the tie
apply a different threshold after recording the selected one
arithmetic_domain: all numbers exactly representable binary fractions; no rounding policy ambiguity intended
source_scope: provided decision scores, not trained-model claim; this fixture is independent of candidate table values; original v2 fixtures unchanged
